task: 74B Part 11 -- primary candidate nomination (draft, NOT frozen, NOT validated)
name: CROSS_SECTIONAL_EXTREME_WINNER_SHORT_REVERSION
mechanism: On a completed session (Day0 close), compute each universe symbol's market-adjusted 3-trading-day cumulative displacement: (stock's 3-day cumulative return) minus (SPY's 3-day cumulative return over the same window), using only information complete as of Day0 close. Rank cross-sectionally among universe symbols with a valid value that day. When a symbol's rank is in the TOP 20% (loose band) or TOP 10% (tight band) -- an extreme past outperformer -- enter SHORT at the next trading day's (Day1) OPEN, hypothesizing multi-day mean reversion. Exit at the close of a fixed trading-day horizon (2, 3, or 5 trading days after entry, inclusive of the entry day).

recommended_anchor_cell.reason: The only cell where BOTH symbol-cluster and day-cluster bootstrap CIs exclude zero; a corroborating parameter plateau exists across all 6 (band x horizon) cells sharing the same sign.

decision_point: Day0 close (after the session is complete) -- no intraday timing dependency
exit_semantics: Fixed trading-day horizon close (2D/3D/5D tested; 3D recommended as the anchor). No intraday exit optimization.
